$description: BaseCLF design tokens. Source of truth. theme.css is generated from this file by scripts/build-theme.mjs, and scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs fails if the two drift apart.

$changelog.0.3.0: Every semantic token now resolves to a ramp step, so nothing is reachable except by editing the ramp. Seven ramp steps added: they are not new colours, they are the values dark mode was already using as one-off literals, now named. Two values changed to clear WCAG AA, both under 0.03 OKLCH lightness: attention-500 (the check verdict badge read 4.08:1 on its own tint) and neutral-500 (tertiary text missed AA on tinted surfaces). Colour tokens renamed text-* to ink-*, because --text-sm was a size and --text-secondary was a colour and nothing stopped you confusing them. Added border-control, the only border held to the 3:1 that WCAG 1.4.11 asks of a control boundary.
$changelog.0.2.0: Removed the brass brand accent. Neutral moved warm to cool. The only saturated colours in the product are now the three semantic signals. See EXTERNAL-SKILLS.md section 2.

neutral.$description: Cool neutral, slight blue cast. Reads technical. Never pure #000 or #fff.
neutral.$why-not-warm: A warm paper/espresso neutral paired with a brass accent is a documented AI-design tell. See EXTERNAL-SKILLS.md section 2.

$curve.$note: The design record. Every hex below is exactly oklch(L C 285.8), and check-design-tokens.mjs proves it. Hue is constant so the ramp never shifts temperature; only lightness is designed. Steps are denser at the dark end because that is where dark mode needs resolution.

allow.$description: SIGNAL. Row visible / operation permitted. Never decorative.

deny.$description: SIGNAL. Blocked by policy. Never decorative.

attention.$description: SIGNAL. Missing index, exposed table, config drift. ALSO the focus-ring colour, focus means 'look here', which is the same job.
attention.$why-this-amber: High yellow, near-zero blue channel. Reads as a warning signal, not as a warm-craft brass tone.
attention.$note-500: Darkened from #9A6F00 in v0.3.0. The check badge renders 500 on 50, which measured 4.08:1 and missed AA. Now 4.53:1, and it improved on white too, 4.52 to 5.02.

semantic.$rule: There is NO brand accent. The brand mark is ink. The only saturated colours in the interface are allow, deny and attention.
semantic.$pairing: Every surface has a defined ink that may sit on it, and check-design-tokens.mjs proves all three ink tiers clear 4.5:1 on all six surfaces in both themes. Do not invent a surface without checking what reads on it.
semantic.$no-literals: Every value here is a reference. A literal would be unreachable by editing the ramp, which would quietly make this file stop being the source of truth. The checker rejects literals.

elevation.$rule: Only two shadows exist. Anything else uses a border.
elevation.$note: Values carry the cool neutral-900 (#16161A = rgb 22 22 26). v0.2 left the warm v0.1 rgb(26 24 21) in DESIGN.md and components.md; v0.3.0 removed it.

family.sans: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
family.mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, monospace
family.$serif-note: No serif in the system. Serif is discouraged as a default and banned in dashboards. If a docs page genuinely needs an editorial register, argue for it in the PR.

size.$note: These emit --text-*. Colours emit --ink-*. The two namespaces were merged before v0.3.0, which meant color: var(--text-sm) was silently meaningless rather than an error.

measure.$comment: ~68 characters. Hard cap for reading columns.

icon.$rule: One family per project. Never hand-roll SVG icon paths.

radius.$rule: One knob. Everything else is derived from it, so 3px is a single editable fact rather than four. Inputs and badges take xs, buttons and panels take sm, dialogs and popovers take md, avatars and pills take full. Table cells take none, because data is not a card.

border.$rule: Structure is built from 1px rules, not shadows.
border.$control-note: border-control is the one border held to 3:1. For an input the border IS the boundary that identifies the control, which WCAG 1.4.11 covers. A row separator is not, so it stays hairline.

motion.$rule: No spring. No bounce. No overshoot. `reveal` duration/easing are LANDING ONLY, never in Studio.
